title: Strengthen the full-size retirement-history roundtrip test controls
outcome: The full-size retirement-history test explicitly exercises a retained journal before compaction and, if storage-scale coverage is needed, one SQLite roundtrip without restoring repeated naming loops.
acceptance: A behavioral positive control establishes the retired journal entry is present before full-history compaction, while preserving custody, capacity and no-redelivery checks.
Any full-1024 SQLite storage roundtrip remains bounded to a single save/load and preserves exact notice identities without reintroducing LIMIT+1 real naming loops.
Focused behavioral tests pass without timeout inflation or production retention changes.
